tested_effect: timing-specific 2024-2025 MDD and 5pct expected-shortfall improvement of the full exit-cap-reentry overlay versus matched-validity v1254
statistic: minimum across three scenarios of MDD_reduction/20pct and tail_loss_reduction/15pct
family_wise_rule: Each repetition takes the maximum risk statistic across all 43 pre-null survivors.
pass_rule: Observed statistic must be at least 1 and strictly above both family-wise 95th-percentile thresholds.
interpretation_boundary: Passing validates risk-timing only; it does not reverse the failed marginal-profit null or cumulative Bonferroni failure.
